scope.description: One node that adopted an unpersisted configuration and later returned to the leader state with the vote of a fresh peer, compared with the log entry at its committed configuration index.
assumptions: the node's configuration entry write failed once, so its latest configuration has no supporting entry
the joining peer starts without a configuration, as a fresh node does
excluded: recovery routes where a surviving majority repairs the log
whether such a committed configuration survives a restart

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: one LogStore wrapper fails exactly one StoreLogs call; no target source is replaced
the joining peer starts unbootstrapped with an empty configuration and log, standing in for a fresh node
election and heartbeat timeouts are shortened and the log level is raised to ERROR so the sequence completes quickly

plan_uncertainties: The scenario uses one fresh peer and one injected failure; other recovery routes (for example a surviving majority that repairs the log) are outside this unit.
grounding_unresolved: Restart behaviour of a committed configuration with no supporting entry
Whether a configuration committed this way can survive a restart of the node and be re-derived from the log is not exercised by this unit.
